scenes.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE horizontal 1672x941 desktop screen image of FOM fleet management web console for a supervisor, in Spanish. Narrow right panel 'Cómo funciona' three restrained steps Programar, Revisar desde la app, Atender hallazgos. Fullwidth bottom table Últimos resultados with2 rows results badges.
